concept.hr: Zapis nastaje kad paket krene van; dolazni paket bez zapisa se odbacuje
concept.en: An entry is made when a packet goes out; inbound with no entry is dropped

summary.hr: Usmjernik R prevodi adrese računala A i B, oba s porta 51000, i gradi tablicu prijevoda. PAT ih razlučuje po vanjskom portu, Basic NAT samo po adresi.
summary.en: Router R translates the addresses of hosts A and B, both from port 51000, into its table. PAT tells them apart by outside port, Basic NAT by address.
